name: 7 Brothers
source:
A college freshman living in an Ivy League frat, you’re more than you seem – but so are your seven brothers. At the Rosewood Club, no one is innocent, and guilt is only a matter of perspective.

From [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/7_Brothers]romance-club.fandom[/url]
translation:
作为一名住在常春藤盟校兄弟会的大学新生，你比你看上去的更优秀——但你的七个兄弟也是如此。在紫檀会所，没有人是无辜的，有罪只是一个角度问题。

来自 [url=https://romance-club.fandom.com/wiki/7_Brothers]romance-club.fandom[/url]
